title: Prettiest hunk of plastic junk I've ever owned.
text:
Prettiest hunk of plastic junk I've ever owned.. My wife picked up this Bissell on sale at a local store, we needed a new vacuum and wanted a bagless model that "specialized" in pet hair. What we got was a complete waste of money (nobody listens to me when I say do a little research first). There isn't one thing this vacuum does well - not one! I could say that the candy apple red paint is a nice touch...but I buy vacuums to clean my house, not to look nice when I open the hall closet.

If you like a LOUD vacuum with the suction power of TWO drinking straws, this is the vacuum for you. I think Bissell says in the manual that you have to remove the insert above the canister and clean it every once in awhile. We have one dog and one cat, and have to remove that insert about 2-3 times a month. This isn't a 'bang around the trash can' cleanout, either; I have to take it into the garage and blow it out with the air compressor. Do YOU have a compressor in your garage? There's so many nooks and crannies in the insert that it's pretty much a requirement to blow it out to clear the air passages. I know, I know...the engineers didn't expect this thing to be moving DUSTY AIR through its MULTI CYCLONIC SYSTEM.

That pet brush you see up on the handle? That is a junk extension of a junk device. It falls off at the slightest tap of the main vacuum chassis, and stopped working after 3 uses (you could hear the high-quality plastic bearings making noise during the first use). Right now it lives in the bottom of the closet, because it's useless and just falls off anyway.

There is another brush head on the body of the removable canister, which falls off 50% less than the pet brush. This one actually collects the pet hair so you can pick it out by hand and spoon-feed it to the vacuum. In fact, you'll be hand-feeding this hunk of crap more than you think - it needs a LOT of help. Find any hair/crumbs/glitter/anything on your carpet? You'll be making at least two passes before Ol' Faithful even considers picking it up...and then you stand a good chance of the offending item getting dropped out of the vacuum head as soon as you turn it off. It doesn't even pick up pet hair, which is what seems to be a selling point judging by all the dumb stickers on this thing. It's like an auto body guy from NASCAR works in Bissell's marketing department - STICKERS EVERYWHERE.

The hose itself is pretty inflexible and just about long enough, and the hose extension is another quality design by those Bissell MBAs...I mean, engineers. The extension has a twist lock in the middle, which will crack after maybe 6 months of use...rendering it useless as well. I've checked multiple times, and there are no blockages in any passageways; this thing is just very poorly designed.

Overall, keep looking right past this thing. It may look nice, but that's about it.

product_metadata.title: BISSELL Lift-Off Multi-Cyclonic Pet Upright Vacuum, 89Q9
features: 12 amp bagless upright vacuum cleaner with detachable canister
Multi-cyclonic system for maximum suction power; 15-inch cleaning path
Adjustable height; dual-edge cleaning; easy-empty dirt cup; Multi-Level Filtration
Includes Pet Hair TurboBrush, crevice tool, and upholstery/dusting brush
Measures 13-1/2 by 15 by 44 inches; 1-year limited warranty
description: The Lift-Off Multi Cyclonic Pet vacuum provides 2 machines in 1, as it combines the best aspects of canister and upright vacuums into one effective, easy-to-store machine. To detach the canister, just “Press, Grab & Go.” The large rectangular button on the top of the canister releases it from the vacuum’s frame when pressed. Once you press, raise the carry handle and take the canister (without its heavy frame and floor brush) with you wherever you would like to clean. You can attach any of the tools to the hose, like the Pet TurboBrush Tool, and remove tracked-in dirt and pet hair from the places you can’t reach with your vacuum’s floor brush.

LiftOffPetCyclonic Equipped with a multi-cyclonic system and a powerful 12 amp motor, this bagless upright vacuum cleaner provides maximum suction power for thoroughly cleaning the home from top to bottom. The unit effectively removes pet hair, dust, dirt, and dry spills from both carpets and bare-floor surfaces, while its stretch hose and onboard attachments make above-floor cleaning a snap. Use the Pet Hair TurboBrush for upholstery and stairs, the crevice tool to access narrow spaces, and the combination upholstery/dusting brush to clean tabletops, bookshelves, furniture, and more.
The detachable canister goes anywhere with you, so you can clean stairs and other hard to reach areas that are almost inaccessible with conventional upright vacuums .
Uses a pre-motor filter, and a pleated post-motor filter. The filter helps reduce household allergens.

Provides surround suction to clean hard to reach places like baseboards and around furniture thoroughly and completely removing pet hair, dirt and debris. The Rotating brush power switch, allows for cleaning carpeted and barefloors
It's easier than ever to dispose of the mess that your Bissell Lift-Off MultiCyclonic Pet vacuum picks up.  Just lift off the container and pour into your wastebasket.

Contains a full assortment of tools including a the Pet Turbobrush crevice tool, combination dusting/upholstery brush and telescoping extension wand. The Pet Turbobrush eraser too has innovative brush design to provide exceptional pet hair clean up on stairs furniture and upholstery
With 12 amps of power, the Multi-Cyclonic System extends suction for a better cleaning performance so you capture even more dirt, dust and debris.
